codeReview.summary: The feature successfully adds Playwright-based browser-test infrastructure, deterministic CSV fixtures, and behavior-focused coverage for several dashboard states. However, the committed harness is not portable because the Playwright webServer command is hard-coded to the original developer’s absolute checkout path, so the harness will fail to start in any other local clone or CI workspace.

issues.description: The Playwright webServer command hard-codes `/Users/treygoff/Code/prospera-team-dashboard` as the served directory. This means `npx playwright test` only works from that exact machine path; in any other checkout location the server will either fail to start or serve the wrong directory, breaking the browser-test harness the feature was supposed to add in-repo. The harness should derive the repo path dynamically (for example from the current working directory or config file location) rather than embedding a user-specific absolute path.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The environment/library guidance does not mention that Playwright browser binaries must be installed separately from the npm package. The worker hit this immediately and had to recover by running `npx playwright install chromium` after the first focused test run failed.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff verification log at /Users/treygoff/.factory/missions/c8e0bdf9-ea59-4a57-99ee-3f3701789359/handoffs/2026-04-08T01-48-03-760Z__add-browser-test-harness__fc58ccfe-7fae-45c0-9566-856ab3c49fb3.json lines 33-37 shows the initial failure due to missing browser binaries followed by `npx playwright install chromium`; .factory/library/environment.md only says browser testing tooling must be installed in-repo, not that browser binaries are a separate prerequisite.

summary: Review failed. The feature adds the requested Playwright harness and deterministic fixtures, but the committed config hard-codes a machine-specific absolute repo path in `playwright.config.js`, so the harness is not reliably runnable outside the original checkout.
